title: Statistical comparison of reconstruction methods for the inverse boundary problem of the one-dimensional wave equation
summary: Several numerical reconstruction algorithms for the inverse boundary value problem of the 1-dimensional wave equation exist. In this paper we revisit two of them, the Sondhi-Gopinath (SG) method from 1971 and the Korpela-Lassas-Oksanen (KLO) method from 2016. Our main contribution is a systematic and statistical comparison of the performance of these two well established methods. The stability of the SG algorithm, even in practical applications, is well known. KLO has a regularisation scheme with a theoretical proof, and is an evolution of the boundary control method.
